For example, if I go into the recipes select add to grocery list, I either need to have the recipe assigned to a particular list already or I have to select which grocery list for each individual item in the recipes. Alternatively, from within whatever grocery list I’m working on, I can add a recipe. However, I need to scroll down through the entire database of foods I have ever used in the application prior to getting to the recipes. If, within a particular grocery list, there was a button that says add recipe that would bypass this need to scroll through several pages of grocery items.
